parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the previous API call. For more information about how to view the returned data, see the operation description above.

parameters.name: ResourceArn
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the resource.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the data protection rule. Optional. If not specified, results are not filtered by rule.
